add-watermark-extract-images-from-pdf.title: Add Watermark to PDF Pages and Extract Images
add-watermark-extract-images-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to overlay a PNG watermark on each page of a PDF using PdfFileMend, then extract all images from the watermarked PDF with PdfExtractor and save them as PNG files.

async-extract-text-and-images-from-pdf.title: Async Extract Text And Images From Pdf

async-pdf-text-extraction-with-cancellat.title: Async Pdf Text Extraction With Cancellation

async-pdf-text-image-extraction.title: Asynchronous PDF Text and Image Extraction
async-pdf-text-image-extraction.description: Demonstrates how to extract text and images from a PDF file asynchronously using Aspose.Pdf's PdfExtractor with Task.Run and cancellation support, keeping UI threads responsive.

batch-extract-text-from-pdfs.title: Batch Extract Text from PDFs
batch-extract-text-from-pdfs.description: Shows how to iterate over a folder of PDF files, extract their text with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor, and save each output as a .txt file using the same base name.

batch-extract-text-from-pdfs__v2.title: Batch Extract Text from PDFs with PdfExtractor
batch-extract-text-from-pdfs__v2.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract text from every PDF file in a folder and save each as a .txt file.

batch-pdf-text-extraction-azure-blob.title: Batch Pdf Text Extraction Azure Blob

cancel-pdf-image-extraction.title: Cancel PDF Image Extraction with InterruptMonitor
cancel-pdf-image-extraction.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf's InterruptMonitor and a CancellationToken to abort a PdfExtractor image extraction operation when the user requests cancellation.

check-pdf-contains-text.title: Check if PDF Contains Text via MemoryStream
check-pdf-contains-text.description: Shows how to bind a PDF to Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor, extract its text into a MemoryStream, and determine whether the document contains any text.

check-pdf-for-text-and-images.title: Check PDF for Both Text and Images
check-pdf-for-text-and-images.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to determine whether a PDF file contains at least one text fragment and one image.

check-pdf-text-only-by-detecting-images.title: Check if PDF is Text‑Only by Detecting Images
check-pdf-text-only-by-detecting-images.description: Demonstrates using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to determine whether a PDF contains any images, indicating if it is text‑only.

check-pdf-text-only-by-extracting-images.title: Check Pdf Text Only By Extracting Images

configurable-pdf-extraction.title: Configurable PDF Text, Image, and Attachment Extraction
configurable-pdf-extraction.description: Demonstrates reading a JSON configuration to enable or disable text, image, and attachment extraction from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PdfExtractor facade.

convert-pdf-to-multi-page-tiff.title: Convert Pdf To Multi Page Tiff

create-a-batch-job-that-processes-pdfs-f.title: Create A Batch Job That Processes Pdfs From An Azure Blob Container Extracting Text And Uploading Results Back

create-contact-sheet-pdf-from-extracted-.title: Create Contact Sheet PDF from Extracted Images
create-contact-sheet-pdf-from-extracted-.description: The example extracts all images from a source PDF using PdfExtractor, then arranges them as thumbnails on a grid to generate a new contact‑sheet PDF.

create-pdf-summary-from-first-three-page.title: Create PDF Summary from First Three Pages Text
create-pdf-summary-from-first-three-page.description: Demonstrates extracting text from the first three pages of a PDF using PdfExtractor and generating a new PDF that contains the extracted text as a summary.

export-pdf-images-to-jpeg-quality-85.title: Export Pdf Images To Jpeg Quality 85

extract-all-images-from-pdf.title: Extract All Images from PDF using PdfExtractor
extract-all-images-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf's PdfExtractor facade to extract every image from a PDF document and save them as PNG files.

extract-attachments-compute-sha256.title: Extract PDF Attachments and Compute SHA-256 Hashes
extract-attachments-compute-sha256.description: Demonstrates creating a PDF with an embedded file, extracting all attachments using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor, and calculating a SHA‑256 hash for each extracted file to verify integrity.

extract-embedded-attachments-from-pdf.title: Extract Embedded Attachments from PDF
extract-embedded-attachments-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to retrieve embedded file attachments from a PDF and save each one to a specified output folder.

extract-images-and-compress-png-zip.title: Extract Images from PDF and Compress as PNG ZIP
extract-images-and-compress-png-zip.description: Demonstrates extracting embedded images from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor, saving them as PNG files, and then losslessly compressing the images into a ZIP archive.

extract-images-and-create-thumbnails.title: Extract Images from PDF and Create Thumbnails
extract-images-and-create-thumbnails.description: Shows how to extract images from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor and generate PNG thumbnails with a maximum dimension of 200 pixels.

extract-images-by-keyword.title: Extract Images from PDF Pages Containing a Keyword
extract-images-by-keyword.description: Shows how to use PdfExtractor to scan each PDF page for a specific keyword and extract only the images from pages where the keyword is present.

extract-images-create-pdf-portfolio.title: Extract Images from PDF and Build an Image Portfolio
extract-images-create-pdf-portfolio.description: Demonstrates how to extract all images from an existing PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor and then create a new PDF where each extracted image occupies its own page, forming a simple portfolio.

extract-images-create-sprite-sheet.title: Extract Images from PDF and Create a Sprite Sheet
extract-images-create-sprite-sheet.description: Demonstrates how to extract all images from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor and combine them into a single horizontal sprite sheet PNG.

extract-images-first-page-to-byte-arrays.title: Extract Images from First PDF Page into Byte Arrays
extract-images-first-page-to-byte-arrays.description: The example creates a minimal PDF containing an in‑memory BMP image, then uses Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract all images from the first page directly into byte arrays for further processing.

extract-images-from-a-pdf-and-embed-them.title: Extract Images From A Pdf And Embed Them Into An Html Report Using Base64 Data Uris

extract-images-from-encrypted-pdf.title: Extract Images from Encrypted PDF with Password
extract-images-from-encrypted-pdf.description: Shows how to open an encrypted PDF by supplying the user password and extract all images using Aspose.Pdf's PdfExtractor.

extract-images-from-first-pdf-page.title: Extract Images From First Pdf Page

extract-images-from-pages-png.title: Extract Images from Specific PDF Pages as PNG
extract-images-from-pages-png.description: Demonstrates using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract images from pages 5 through 10 of a PDF and save each image as a PNG file.

extract-images-from-pdf-pages-png.title: Extract Images From Pdf Pages Png

extract-images-from-pdf-to-base64-json.title: Extract Images From Pdf To Base64 Json

extract-images-from-pdf-to-temp-folder.title: Extract Images from PDF to Temporary Folder
extract-images-from-pdf-to-temp-folder.description: Demonstrates extracting all images from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PdfExtractor with the default extraction mode and saving them as JPEG files in a uniquely created temporary directory.

extract-images-from-pdf-to-unc.title: Extract Images from PDF to UNC Network Share
extract-images-from-pdf-to-unc.description: Demonstrates using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to pull all images from a PDF and save them as PNG files to a network‑mapped UNC folder.

extract-images-from-pdf-to-zip.title: Extract Images from PDF and Create ZIP Archive
extract-images-from-pdf-to-zip.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf to extract all images from a PDF document and package them into a ZIP file using .NET's ZipArchive.

extract-images-from-pdf-using-pdfextract.title: Extract Images from PDF Using PdfExtractor with Automatic Disposal
extract-images-from-pdf-using-pdfextract.description: Demonstrates binding a PDF to Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor, extracting all images, and saving them to a folder while using a using block to automatically dispose the extractor.

extract-images-from-pdf-with-guid-filena.title: Extract Images from PDF with GUID Filenames
extract-images-from-pdf-with-guid-filena.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract all images from a PDF and save each as a PNG file with a unique GUID‑based filename to prevent naming collisions.

extract-images-from-specific-pdf-page.title: Extract Images from a Specific PDF Page
extract-images-from-specific-pdf-page.description: Shows how to extract all images from a single PDF page by setting the StartPage and EndPage properties of PdfExtractor.

extract-images-html-gallery.title: Extract Images from PDF and Create HTML Gallery
extract-images-html-gallery.description: Demonstrates extracting all images from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor and generating a simple HTML page that displays the extracted PNG files.

extract-images-markdown-gallery.title: Extract Images from PDF and Generate a Markdown Gallery
extract-images-markdown-gallery.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to pull images from a PDF and create a markdown file that displays those images as a gallery.

extract-images-ocr-openai-copilot.title: Extract Images from PDF and Perform OCR with OpenAI Copilot
extract-images-ocr-openai-copilot.description: The example extracts all images from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor, saves each image, and then runs OCR on the saved images with Aspose.Pdf.AI OpenAIOcrCopilot (OpenAI) to retrieve hidden textual content.

extract-images-original-format-pdfextrac.title: Extract Images in Original Format Using PdfExtractor
extract-images-original-format-pdfextrac.description: Demonstrates how to extract images from a PDF while preserving their original format by setting ExtractImageMode to DefinedInResources and using GetNextImage without specifying an image format.

extract-images-pdf-create-video-slidesho.title: Extract Images from PDF and Create a Video Slideshow
extract-images-pdf-create-video-slidesho.description: Demonstrates how to extract all images from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades and then generate a video slideshow from the extracted pictures with FFmpeg.

extract-images-pdf-csv-index.title: Extract Images from PDF and Create CSV Index
extract-images-pdf-csv-index.description: The example opens a PDF, extracts all embedded images, saves each as a PNG file, and generates a CSV file that lists the image filename, page number, and dimensions.

extract-images-pdf-csv-manifest.title: Extract Images from PDF and Generate CSV Manifest
extract-images-pdf-csv-manifest.description: Demonstrates how to extract all images from each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades, save them as PNG files, and create a CSV file that lists each image's file name, page number, and dimensions.

extract-images-pdf-to-base64-json.title: Extract Images from PDF to Base64 JSON
extract-images-pdf-to-base64-json.description: Demonstrates extracting all images from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor, converting them to PNG, encoding them as Base64, and writing a JSON array with image metadata.

extract-images-to-base64.title: Extract Images from PDF and Convert to Base64
extract-images-to-base64.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to pull each image from a PDF, convert the image stream to a Base64 string, and serialize the collection to JSON.

extract-images-to-bmp.title: Extract Images from PDF and Save as BMP
extract-images-to-bmp.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract all images from a PDF and save them as BMP files while preserving the original resolution and color depth.

extract-images-to-html-report.title: Extract Images from PDF and Embed in HTML Report
extract-images-to-html-report.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract images from a PDF, convert them to Base64 data URIs, and generate an HTML report containing the images.

extract-images-to-pdfa2b.title: Extract Images and Generate PDF/A‑2b Document
extract-images-to-pdfa2b.description: The example extracts all images from an existing PDF, embeds them as XObjects in a new PDF, and converts the result to PDF/A‑2b compliance using Aspose.Pdf.

extract-images-to-tiff.title: Extract Images from PDF and Save as TIFF
extract-images-to-tiff.description: Demonstrates extracting all images from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor and saving each image as a lossless TIFF file for archival storage.

extract-images-to-unc-share.title: Extract Images from PDF to UNC Network Share
extract-images-to-unc-share.description: Demonstrates how to extract all images from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades and save them to a UNC network share, creating the destination folder if needed.

extract-images-validate-signature.title: Extract Images from PDF and Validate Their Signatures
extract-images-validate-signature.description: Demonstrates how to extract images from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor, then verify each image's file signature (magic number) and rename it with the correct extension.

extract-pdf-attachments-by-extension.title: Extract PDF Attachments and Organize by File Extension
extract-pdf-attachments-by-extension.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to pull embedded attachments from a PDF and save them into subfolders grouped by their original file extensions.

extract-pdf-attachments-with-timestamp.title: Extract PDF Attachments and Save with Timestamped Filenames
extract-pdf-attachments-with-timestamp.description: The example extracts all embedded file attachments from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor, prefixes each filename with a timestamp, and saves them to a specified folder.

extract-pdf-images-create-video-slidesho.title: Extract Pdf Images Create Video Slideshow

extract-pdf-images-to-azure-blob.title: Extract Images from PDF and Upload to Azure Blob Storage
extract-pdf-images-to-azure-blob.description: Demonstrates extracting all images from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor and uploading each image to an Azure Blob container.

extract-pdf-images-to-gcs.title: Extract Images from PDF and Upload to Google Cloud Storage
extract-pdf-images-to-gcs.description: Demonstrates using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to pull images from a PDF and upload each image to a Google Cloud Storage bucket with public read access.

extract-pdf-images-to-jpeg-quality-85.title: Extract PDF Images to JPEG with Quality 85
extract-pdf-images-to-jpeg-quality-85.description: Demonstrates extracting all images from a PDF and saving them as JPEG files with a quality setting of 85 using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfConverter.

extract-pdf-images-to-s3-with-encryption.title: Extract Pdf Images To S3 With Encryption

extract-pdf-images-to-s3.title: Extract Images from PDF and Upload to Amazon S3
extract-pdf-images-to-s3.description: Demonstrates how to extract each image from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and upload the resulting files to an Amazon S3 bucket with the AWS SDK.

extract-pdf-text-and-encrypt-aes.title: Extract Text from PDF and Encrypt with AES
extract-pdf-text-and-encrypt-aes.description: Demonstrates extracting all text from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PdfExtractor facade, saving it to a temporary file, and then encrypting that file with AES‑256 before storing the result.

extract-pdf-text-in-memory.title: Extract PDF Text In-Memory Using PdfExtractor
extract-pdf-text-in-memory.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF from a MemoryStream, extracting its text with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor, and returning the result in another MemoryStream for further in‑memory processing.

extract-pdf-text-page-by-page.title: Extract Pdf Text Page By Page

extract-pdf-text-per-page-progress.title: Extract Pdf Text Per Page Progress

extract-pdf-text-per-page.title: Extract PDF Text and Save Each Page to a File
extract-pdf-text-per-page.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract the full text of a PDF and then split it into separate per‑page text files.

extract-pdf-text-to-azure-table.title: Extract PDF Text and Store in Azure Table
extract-pdf-text-to-azure-table.description: Demonstrates how to extract text from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades and save the extracted content as an entity in Azure Table storage.

extract-pdf-text-to-gzip.title: Extract PDF Text and Compress to GZip
extract-pdf-text-to-gzip.description: Demonstrates extracting all text from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor and writing it directly to a GZip compressed stream to reduce storage size.

extract-pdf-text-to-memory-stream.title: Extract Pdf Text To Memory Stream

extract-pdf-text-to-memorystream.title: Extract PDF Text to MemoryStream for Further Processing
extract-pdf-text-to-memorystream.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract text from a PDF, store it in a MemoryStream, and prepare the stream for consumption by another component.

extract-pdf-text-to-postgresql.title: Extract PDF Text and Store in PostgreSQL
extract-pdf-text-to-postgresql.description: Demonstrates how to extract Unicode text from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and insert the extracted content into a PostgreSQL table for searchable indexing.

extract-pdf-text-to-stringbuilder.title: Extract PDF Text to StringBuilder
extract-pdf-text-to-stringbuilder.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract text from a PDF, store it in a StringBuilder for further manipulation, and then write it to a file.

extract-pdf-text-to-stringwriter.title: Extract PDF Text to StringWriter for Logging
extract-pdf-text-to-stringwriter.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract all text from a PDF, capture it in a MemoryStream, convert it to a string, and write it to a StringWriter for integration with logging frameworks.

extract-pdf-text-to-utf8-file.title: Extract Pdf Text To Utf8 File

extract-pdf-text-utf8.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract text from a PDF document and write it to a UTF‑8 encoded text file.

extract-pdf-text-verify-temp-file.title: Extract Pdf Text Verify Temp File

extract-pdf-text-with-progress.title: Extract PDF Text with Page-by-Page Progress Reporting
extract-pdf-text-with-progress.description: Demonstrates how to extract text from each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PdfExtractor while reporting progress in the console.

extract-pdf-text-with-progress__v2.title: Extract PDF Text per Page with Progress Indicator
extract-pdf-text-with-progress__v2.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf's PdfExtractor to extract text from each page of a PDF and display a percentage‑based progress update.

extract-text-and-images-from-pdf.title: Extract Text and Images from PDF using PdfExtractor
extract-text-and-images-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to create a PdfExtractor, bind it to a PDF file, and simultaneously extract both the document text and embedded images, saving them to separate outputs.

extract-text-and-images-from-pdfs.title: Extract Text and Images from PDFs using PdfExtractor
extract-text-and-images-from-pdfs.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract all text to a .txt file and save each embedded image as PNG from PDF files in a mounted directory.

extract-text-from-password-protected-pdf.title: Extract Text From Password Protected Pdf

extract-text-from-pdf-byte-array.title: Extract Text from PDF Byte Array Using PdfExtractor
extract-text-from-pdf-byte-array.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract all text from a PDF supplied as a byte array entirely in memory, without writing any files to disk.

extract-text-from-pdf-byte-array__v2.title: Extract Text from PDF Byte Array using Aspose.Pdf
extract-text-from-pdf-byte-array__v2.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF from a byte array, extract its textual content with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor, and return the result as JSON.

extract-text-from-pdf-pages-with-progres.title: Extract Text From Pdf Pages With Progress Bar

extract-text-from-pdf-to-utf8-txt.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract plain text from a PDF document and save it as a UTF-8 encoded .txt file.

extract-text-from-pdf.title: Extract Text from PDF using Aspose PdfExtractor
extract-text-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with PdfExtractor, extracting its text content, and outputting the Unicode text to the console.

extract-text-from-pdf__v2.title: Extract Text from PDF using PdfExtractor
extract-text-from-pdf__v2.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract all text from a PDF file and output it to the console.

extract-text-from-protected-pdf.title: Extract Text from Password-Protected PDF
extract-text-from-protected-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to provide the owner password to a PdfExtractor, bind an encrypted PDF, and extract its text to a file using Aspose.Pdf.

extract-text-only-ignore-images.title: Extract Text Only from PDF Using PdfExtractor (Ignore Images)
extract-text-only-ignore-images.description: Demonstrates how to configure Aspose.Pdf's PdfExtractor to ignore images by omitting the ExtractImage call and extract only the textual content of a PDF.

extract-text-to-temp-file-and-verify.title: Extract PDF Text to Temporary File and Verify
extract-text-to-temp-file-and-verify.description: Demonstrates extracting text from a PDF using PdfExtractor, saving it to a temporary file, reading it back, and confirming the extracted content matches the original string.

handle-corrupted-pdf-binding.title: Handle Corrupted PDF Binding with PdfExtractor
handle-corrupted-pdf-binding.description: Demonstrates checking for a PDF file's existence and catching exceptions thrown by PdfExtractor when binding a corrupted PDF, using specific Aspose.Pdf exception types.

list-embedded-attachment-names.title: List Embedded Attachment Names in PDF
list-embedded-attachment-names.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to retrieve the names of all embedded attachments in a PDF without extracting the files.

parallel-image-extraction-from-pdfs.title: Parallel Image Extraction from Multiple PDFs
parallel-image-extraction-from-pdfs.description: Demonstrates how to extract all images from several PDF files concurrently using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor and Task.WhenAll for improved throughput.

pdf-extractor-unit-test.title: Unit Test for Extracting Text with PdfExtractor
pdf-extractor-unit-test.description: Demonstrates creating a simple PDF, extracting its text using Aspose.Pdf's PdfExtractor, and verifying the extracted content with an NUnit unit test.

report-pdf-page-image-attachment-counts.title: Report PDF Page, Image, and Attachment Counts
report-pdf-page-image-attachment-counts.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades to determine the total number of pages, embedded images, and file attachments in a PDF document.

retry-pdf-text-extraction.title: Retry PDF Text Extraction on IOException
retry-pdf-text-extraction.description: Demonstrates how to extract text from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PdfExtractor with a retry loop that handles IOException and attempts the operation up to three times.

test-image-extraction-mode-pdf-extractor.title: Test Image Extraction Mode with PdfExtractor
